'''July 2000 Normal tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Normal, Illinois on 11 July 2000. [[Geoff Snider]] won it. It is known from Geoff Snider's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d998">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-11-normal-illinois-7-11-2000d998/ normal-illinois-7-11-2000], DeckTech (Geoff "gsiva" Snider, 11 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-11-normal-illinois-7-11-2000d998/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 11 July 2000
* '''Site:''' Normal, Illinois
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Geoff Snider]]
